scope: all nine subjects, all three arms; repeated recorded answers compared separately

findings.detail: Rationale guesses monitoring role from names and uses flow-observer/socai2-flow rather than full input identities. Recommendations retain full names; program binding does not use these prose names.
Both call current TI not_queried a no-hit/empty result. Current also calls the matching history empty; input_only correctly acknowledges history matches.

TI-empty wording follows prior analysis and may refer to previous login rather than current process lookup; do not code it as an unqualified definite current-query false claim. Account date suffix is used to speculate a temporary session.
Process-start success and a command line are described as execution of the command; no completion/output evidence was supplied.

Recommendation about current TI emptiness cites N1_S15/N1_S24, both prior triage analyses, rather than the current query receipt. Valid IDs do not prove the statement is grounded in the correct occurrence.

Nominal benign judgment has direct data but also source_label refs in decision_basis; existing parser rejects alert_decision_basis_not_direct. Five-field generation constrains this list before parsing.
All needs_review; acceptable uncertainty under user policy, not successful malicious classification or a directional reversal.
fleetWidePattern is attributed to detection labels, source vendor is treated as management-agent vendor, and command is described as registry retrieval without supplied evidence.

Needs_review changes to benign based on management parent, signed inventory content and fleet pattern. Zero recorded process network connections is expanded to no attempted exfiltration; this is not fully proven.

All needs_review. Current treats departure status as potential expected/authorized behavior; input_only explicitly distinguishes status from nature of activity. Candidate hypotheses do not establish actual authorization.

All true_positive. First two basis lists mix roles and core is rejected; five-field output accepted but has zero recommendations compared with two/one. Empty advice is allowed, its business sufficiency remains unverified.

180 prior runs does not mean 180 successful runs. Only preceding hour is said to have no failed statements; outputs merge or explicitly extend that absence to all 180 runs. Five-field parser accepts this false unsupported claim.

evaluation_material_issues.detail: Frozen author label is false_positive, candidate returns benign. Current contract defines false_positive as refuted description, while the title reports encoded PowerShell. Keep original label and report mismatch; adjudicate before a new batch.
Fixture activity is 03:06 UTC; unchanged schedule says nightly 02:10 without timezone. Cannot prove schedule match. No post-hoc alteration or accuracy claim from this fixture.

decision: Keep prototype separate from production. Performance gain observed; factual correctness, sample taxonomy/time, advice sufficiency and end-to-end integration remain unaccepted. No evidence that the checked factual errors were caused by adapter deletion; that is not a proof of universal losslessness.
